
'''Ōtomo Shrine''' (大伴神社) refers to several shrines in Japan.

* {{ill|Ōtomo Shrine|ja|大伴神社 (高岡市)|qid=Q11432351}} - Located in Fushiki Ichinomiya, Takaoka City, Toyama Prefecture.
* {{ill|Ōtomo Shrine (Saku, Mochizuki)|ja|大伴神社 (佐久市望月)|qid=Q111333730}} - Located in Mochizuki, Saku City, Nagano Prefecture. Considered a candidate for an {{ill|Ancient shrine|ja|式内社|lt=Shikinaisha}}.
* {{ill|Ōtomo Shrine (Saku, Nozawa)|ja|大伴神社 (佐久市野澤)}} - Located in Nozawa, Saku City, Nagano Prefecture.
* {{ill|Ōtomo Shrine (Ōtsu)|ja|大伴神社 (大津市)}} - Located in Minamishiga, Ōtsu City, Shiga Prefecture. Also known as Ōtomo Kurohito Shrine or Ōtomo Kurohito Shrine.
* {{ill|Sumiyoshi Ōtomo Shrine|ja|住吉大伴神社|qid=Q17994598}} - Located in Ryōanji Sumiyoshichō, Ukyo-ku, Kyoto City, Kyoto Prefecture. Considered a candidate for an ancient shrine.
* {{ill|Ōtomo Kurohito Shrine|ja|大伴黒主神社}} - Located in Yamanakata-chō, Tondabayashi City, Osaka Prefecture.
